messages.subject: fixed issue with mean, variance, and sd
parts:
I just pushed a patch that fixes the mean, variance
and sd issue brought to our attention by dynotec
on the user's mailing list. Thanks again for the report.

The fix is available as of now in the Git repository,
but it'll take some time to push through to RStan
and the source tarball.

We're really hoping to release the official 1.0
version next week (while it's still August!).
After that, we'll be tracking which bug fixes go in
which releases more closely.

(For the stan-dev x-post: The root cause was using a double
rather than the template parameter for accumulators and using
a double rather than promoting the template param for return
type. I also added unit tests and error handling for size
boundary issues, such as trying to take the sample mean
of a length zero vector or the sample variance of
a length one vector.)

- Bob
